dotenv.file:
# a comment
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_A=one # trailing
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_B="two
lines"
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_C=${VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_A}-x
export VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_D = spaced
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_E
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_F='lit ${VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_A}'
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_G="esc \t tab \" quote"
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_H=${VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_UNSET:-fallback}
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_I=a#not-a-comment
'VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_J'=quoted key
malformed line without a separator
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_K=
VIBE_PARITY_DOTENV_A=redefined
dotenv.name: dotenv-python-dotenv-grammar

entries.name: static-auth-block
entries.toml:
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "https://docs.example/mcp"

[mcp_servers.auth]
type = "static"
api_key_env = "VIBE_PARITY_MCP_TOKEN"
api_key_header = "X-Api-Key"
api_key_format = "Token {token}"
headers = { X-Trace = "on" }

entries.name: static-auth-token-format-spec
entries.toml:
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "https://docs.example/mcp"

[mcp_servers.auth]
type = "static"
api_key_env = "VIBE_PARITY_MCP_TOKEN"
api_key_format = "Bearer {token:>8}"

entries.name: static-auth-invalid-header
entries.toml:
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "https://docs.example/mcp"

[mcp_servers.auth]
type = "static"

entries.name: static-auth-duplicate-header
entries.toml:
[[mcp_servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "https://docs.example/mcp"

[mcp_servers.auth]

entries.name: explicit-header-wins-over-token
entries.toml:

[mcp_servers.auth]
